subject.title: chore(checks): prune stale max-lines and session-accessor baselines breaking CI on main

question: Should this focused contributor branch be accepted as an exception to the known-main-CI contribution policy, or closed in favor of a maintainer-owned repair?
rationale: The implementation is correct and proof-positive, but repository policy explicitly reserves already-red main CI repairs for the maintainer team; automation cannot choose whether to waive that policy here.

options.title: Use maintainer-owned repair
options.body: Close this PR under the documented contribution policy and apply the same generated baseline deletions directly through the maintainer workflow.

options.title: Sponsor this exception
options.body: Rebase this PR onto current `main`, rerun both exact guards, and merge it with explicit maintainer approval despite the normal intake policy.

recommendation.title: Use maintainer-owned repair
recommendation.body: Close this PR under the documented contribution policy and apply the same generated baseline deletions directly through the maintainer workflow.
